tree.heading: Conservation Area
tree.text: The term “Conservation Area” means the McInnis Canyons National Conservation Area established by section 460mmm–2(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Council
tree.text: The term “Council” means the McInnis Canyons National Conservation Area Advisory Council established under section 460mmm–6 of this title.

tree.heading: Management plan
tree.text: The term “management plan” means the management plan developed for the Conservation Area under section 460mmm–4(h) of this title.

tree.heading: Map
tree.text: The term “Map” means the map entitled “Proposed Colorado Canyons National Conservation Area and Black Ridge Canyons Wilderness Area” and dated July 18, 2000.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Director of the Bureau of Land Management.

tree.heading: Wilderness
tree.text: The term “Wilderness” means the Black Ridge Canyons Wilderness so designated in section 460mmm–3 of this title.

notes.text: Effective Date of 2004 AmendmentAmendment by Pub. L. 108–400 effective Jan. 1, 2005, see section 1(g) of Pub. L. 108–400, set out as a note under section 460mmm of this title.
